templates.name: Floating shelf
templates.description: Plan, measure and install a small shelf. Choose suitable anchors for your wall and check for cables before drilling.
steps: Check the marks with the level.
Fit the brackets and shelf following their instructions.
Check stability and take a final photo.

templates.name: Paint a picture frame
templates.description: Refresh an old frame and record the result.
steps: Remove the backing and clean the frame.
Prepare the surface as directed by the paint manufacturer.
